title: Stock Room

scenario.intro: New stock arrives at the vault door. The clerk writes it in by pasting names into SQL, and a captain's log just crashed the desk.
scenario.goal: Add items with an `INSERT` and `?` parameters, answer the new id, and refuse vaults that don't exist.

objective: Every delivery is shelved, apostrophes and all, and nothing lands in a vault that isn't there.
rules: Insert the item with `?` parameters (a name may contain a `'`).
Answer `201` with the new `id` (`cur.lastrowid`) and the `name`.
A vault that doesn't exist answers `404`, and nothing is added.

public_tests.name: The log is on the shelf

hints.text: Two jobs: check the vault exists before inserting, and never paste the name into the SQL (the ' in Captain's Log ends the string early).
INSERT INTO items (name, vault, price) VALUES (?, ?, ?) with a three-item tuple. SELECT 1 FROM vaults WHERE name = ? finds the vault; fetchone() is None when it's missing.
Raise HTTPException(status_code=404) when the vault is missing, then run the INSERT inside `with db:` and return {"id": cur.lastrowid, "name": body.name}.

dialogue.start: One apostrophe and the whole stock desk fell over. Let's shelve things properly.
dialogue.success: Every box on its shelf, even the captain's. And no deliveries to imaginary vaults.
dialogue.fail: Some deliveries crashed the desk or went to a vault that isn't there.
